llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves C1 (header), A11 (label), and B11 (total) from the xlsx file using openpyxl with data_only=True, which properly reads cached formula values after save.
Metric checks all three sub-goals from the instruction: (1) Maturity Date column header in C1, (2) 'Total' label in A11, (3) total loan days value in B11.
Evaluator is resistant to the initial state since row 11 does not exist in the original spreadsheet (only header + 9 data rows).
String comparisons are case-insensitive and stripped; B11 handles float-to-int normalization for Excel-stored numbers.

Minor limitation: the 'Maturity Date column for all loans' requirement is verified only by the C1 header, not by checking actual date values in C2:C10. An agent adding just the header without computing dates earns 0.34 partial credit.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider extending the getter to also read C2:C10 values and verify they are non-null date values, ensuring the Maturity Date column actually contains computed dates for all loans.
